definition.name: Fresh normal Flurl Refit application response-boundary programme

steps.name: Fetch the exact successful native producer source
Check original archive and native provenance boundaries
Check original and corrected normal application source boundaries
Install the normal captured compiler isolation boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Prepare the pinned compiler and current small closed-runtime adapters
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/edges-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/edges-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/edges-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/edges-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Authenticate five original native products without rebuilding
Build one application and execute twelve signed library response boundaries
Retain bounded public original build and library evidence

Replace component-only replay with one normal isolated captured application compilation (original 40-minute compiler job bound), preserving SDK/library versions and execution budgets; add exact two-line application error handling plus two unchanged 404/500 regressions and two preimage controls. Historical baseline/before/coverage preserved; legacy workflows untouched.
